name: mio-expected-calibration-2019-2021q1-20261030
notes: Test B, expected-profit calibration audit (Stream B of the owner-approved four-stream program). Owner authorization, Russell, 2026-10-30: "Okay do all of those and max parallel work. Build with opus, review with sonnet. You orchestrate everything. Kick off any runs please asap." Question: the MIO objective `expected` (USD expected profit under the forecast) selects books; does it carry MAGNITUDE or RANK information about realized book P&L? Read-only on three saved, attested MIO results; no MIO, fit, solver, provider pull, registry write, 2020 label, 2024+ or holdout read; bars read below each cohort's end_before (2020-01-01 for 2019, 2021-04-01 for Q1 2021). Cohorts are kept separate (every gate is per cohort). PRE-REGISTERED GATES (fixed before any clustered band, IC or counterfactual was computed; disclosed: the orchestrator and the builder had already seen the naive unclustered OLS slope, correlation, realized/expected ratio and win rate of the filled books, e.g. 2019 broad212 slope -0.009, Q1 -0.011). G1: per cohort, over ALL filled books, slope b of realized pnl (`outcome`) on `expected_matched` (saved expected scaled by the filled/selected contract fraction, because available-size fills keep `expected` at selected size), two-way cluster-robust (decision_date, symbol) CR1, Cameron-Gelbach-Miller A+B-AxB (wider one-way if that is not positive, flagged), 95% Student-t band on min(G)-1 df. Read: b >= 0.5 and band excludes 0 -> magnitude usable; 0 < b < 0.5 and band excludes 0 -> over-reaction (a shrink factor repairs it); band includes 0 -> no magnitude information; b < 0 with band excluding 0 -> inverted (reported as such, not usable). G2: the same slope split by method_fitted (fitted M53 cell vs raw-model fallback). G3: per decision date, Spearman IC of expected_matched vs realized pnl across the cohort's filled books (series = method|book id), HAC Newey-West mean over dates (automatic lags, h_steps 1), per-cohort split; t > 2 -> rank usable; dates with < 3 books are skipped and a median cross-section < 5 books is flagged unusable by the ordering owner (ADR-0068). G3b: the same over filled+refused books on the uniform decision basis (saved expected vs decision_basis_pnl: the book as selected, at decision prices, fees in, settled at expiry). G4 (informational, no gate): counterfactual settlement of every refused book, summed by method, reason and fitted flag; settlement = the run's own pinned split-adjusted bar close at expiry / the book's basis factor (MIOPacketStudy._settlements), verified by reproducing every filled book's saved pnl within the tolerance. Sensitivities (reported, never gating): G1 on the raw saved expected; G1 clustered by (expiry, symbol), the A0005 dimensions. Path: A0003 windows respected (2019 development; Q1 2021 is a validation-window period whose MIO run already exists and is only re-read here); A0005's promotion rule is not invoked (no promotion); A0002 governs distribution-evaluation metrics and is not contradicted (this is an owner-requested diagnostic of the MIO objective, not a forecast-evaluation metric); A0008 untouched.
